passive_skill_sets.name: Full-Power Final Battle
passive_skill_sets.itemized_description:
*Basic effect(s)*
- ATK & DEF 200%{passiveImg:up_g}
*When HP is 50% or more*
- ATK & DEF 50%{passiveImg:up_g}
*As the 1st attacker in a turn*
- DEF 100%{passiveImg:up_g}
*After collecting Ki Spheres as the 1st attacker in a turn*
- Receives an additional Ki +1 per Ki Sphere obtained within the turn
*As the 2nd attacker in a turn or as the 3rd attacker in a turn*
- ATK 100%{passiveImg:up_g}
*After collecting Ki Spheres as the 2nd attacker in a turn or as the 3rd attacker in a turn*
- Receives an additional Ki +2 per Ki Sphere obtained within the turn
*When attacking with 18 or more Ki*
- Launches an additional attack that has a great chance of becoming a Super Attack
*When attacking with 24 or more Ki*
- Launches an additional Super Attack
*When performing or receiving a Super Attack, for every attack performed*
- {passiveImg:forever}Ki +1 (up to +99)
- {passiveImg:forever}Chance of performing a critical hit 10%{passiveImg:up_g} (up to 50%)

passive_skill_sets.name: Full-Power Final Battle

- ATK & DEF 300%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Guards all attacks

- {passiveImg:once}Damage reduction rate 50%{passiveImg:up_g}

- {passiveImg:once}Damage reduction rate 60%{passiveImg:up_g}
*When receiving an attack*
- {passiveImg:once}{passiveImg:forever}DEF 50%{passiveImg:up_g}
*When attacking with 12 or more Ki*
- ATK 150%{passiveImg:up_g}
*When attacking with 18 or more Ki*
- Launches an additional Super Attack
*When attacking with 24 or more Ki*
- Launches an additional Super Attack
- {passiveImg:once}Launches an additional Super Attack
*When performing or receiving a Super Attack, for every attack performed*
- {passiveImg:forever}Ki +2 (up to +99)
- {passiveImg:forever}Chance of performing a critical hit 20%{passiveImg:up_g} (up to 100%)
*When receiving a Super Attack and as the 1st attacker in a turn*
- Chance of evading enemy's attack 50%{passiveImg:up_g}

- Cancels one of its skills

standby_skill_sets.name: Enters Standby Mode
standby_skill_sets.effect_description:
Stands by for 5 turns, during which 
charge count increases by 1 
per Ki Sphere obtained by allies
standby_skill_sets.condition_description:
Can be activated when HP is 50% or less, 
or starting from the 4th turn from the 
start of battle if the character performs 
4 or more attacks in battle (once only)

finish_skill_sets.name: Spirit Bomb
finish_skill_sets.effect_description:
Raises ATK by 15% temporarily 
per charge count and 
causes ultimate damage to enemy
finish_skill_sets.condition_description:
Can be activated when charge count 
is 38 or less (once only)

finish_skill_sets.name: Super Spirit Bomb
finish_skill_sets.effect_description:
Raises ATK by 20% temporarily 
per charge count and causes 
super-ultimate damage to enemy
finish_skill_sets.condition_description:
Can be activated when charge count 
is 39 or more (once only)
